title: tester-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/devices/tester reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/devices/tester mails with no verb and nothing uses it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a; the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/devices/tester; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 6 tickets at a rest carry a watchme probe under cairn/devices/tester/probes/ (299d4f72ae40, 4431cf2bc625, 481221f45884, 652965bec418, a48f95c51a41, f50706ba15c3). Read 2026-10-03: all six triggers are fails-shaped (_trigger TRUE when the falsifier fails); all six post to='tester', whose receive() (cairn/devices/tester/device.py:352) only emits 'received' and returns accepted, using nothing, so all six retarget to harbor_master. 299d4f72ae40 and 481221f45884 already hold their bare id in _OWNING_TICKET; the other four hold a slug there and gain _TICKET_ID. Three proofs import a tester probe (test_a_first_seal_is_taken_under_the_seal, test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped, test_validation_store); none asserts the probe's to or verb. Each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, <its predicate>), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). 6 post to='tester' (299d4f72ae40, 4431cf2bc625, 481221f45884, 652965bec418, a48f95c51a41, f50706ba15c3) and retarget to='harbor_master'. Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under cairn/devices/tester/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/devices/tester has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing tester spec lacks the receiver, or if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id, or if a probe still posts to tester. WRONG INTENT if a tester probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 6 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside cairn/devices/tester.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which probes and how: 299d4f72ae40 an_open_reading_is_not_silently_converted (fails=_trigger), 4431cf2bc625 seal_measurements_are_not_dropped (fails=_trigger), 481221f45884 a_first_seal_is_taken_under_the_seal (fails=_trigger), 652965bec418 proven_space_stays_populated (fails=_trigger), a48f95c51a41 the_collapse_holds_in_live_traffic (fails=_trigger), f50706ba15c3 a_proof_cannot_seed_the_tree_it_reads (fails=_trigger). In each file under cairn/devices/tester/probes/: append watch_carry to the existing 'from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...' line; use the probe's id constant (named per probe below, added as `_TICKET_ID = "<id>"` after the import block when absent); in PROBE = Probe(...) replace 'carry=_carry,' with 'verb="watch",' and 'carry=watch_carry(<const>, _carry, <pred>),'. For an_open_reading_is_not_silently_converted, seal_measurements_are_not_dropped, a_first_seal_is_taken_under_the_seal, proven_space_stays_populated, the_collapse_holds_in_live_traffic, a_proof_cannot_seed_the_tree_it_reads also change to="tester" to to="harbor_master". Four probes (4431cf2bc625, 652965bec418, a48f95c51a41, f50706ba15c3) hold _OWNING_TICKET as a slug, not the id; that constant stays as it is (their carry and owning_ticket read it), and a new _TICKET_ID carries the 12-hex id for watch_carry. Nothing else in a probe changes. (2) watch_carry exists in cairn/tools/base/probe.py (8ecb99998254); do not edit it. (3) Specs: each ticket's watchme spec whose probe starts with cairn/devices/tester/probes/ gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}, through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write. (4) Proof: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_tester_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'71189b2ddffc': {'all': 'test_tester_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, modeled on cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py. (5) Every proof that imports a converted probe stays green: run them.

decisions.text: D1: the probes — In each of these files under cairn/devices/tester/probes/: an_open_reading_is_not_silently_converted.py (299d4f72ae40: constant _OWNING_TICKET — already present; fails=_trigger), seal_measurements_are_not_dropped.py (4431cf2bc625: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger), a_first_seal_is_taken_under_the_seal.py (481221f45884: constant _OWNING_TICKET — already present; fails=_trigger), proven_space_stays_populated.py (652965bec418: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger), the_collapse_holds_in_live_traffic.py (a48f95c51a41: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger), a_proof_cannot_seed_the_tree_it_reads.py (f50706ba15c3: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger) — append watch_carry to the existing `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line; where the constant is to be added, add `_TICKET_ID = "<its id>"` after the import block; in `PROBE = Probe(...)` replace `carry=_carry,` with `verb="watch",` and `carry=watch_carry(<constant>, _carry, <its predicate>),`. In an_open_reading_is_not_silently_converted, seal_measurements_are_not_dropped, a_first_seal_is_taken_under_the_seal, proven_space_stays_populated, the_collapse_holds_in_live_traffic, a_proof_cannot_seed_the_tree_it_reads also change to="tester" to to="harbor_master". Four probes (4431cf2bc625, 652965bec418, a48f95c51a41, f50706ba15c3) hold _OWNING_TICKET as a slug, not the id; that constant stays as it is (their carry and owning_ticket read it), and a new _TICKET_ID carries the 12-hex id for watch_carry. Nothing else changes; watch_carry is not edited.

D3: the proof — Create cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_tester_probes_report_to_the_watch.py: a copy of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py with the docstring naming cairn/devices/tester and ticket 71189b2ddffc; PROVES = {'71189b2ddffc': {'all': 'test_tester_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}; BERTH = 'cairn/devices/tester/probes/'; _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] (the repo root: the directory holding cairn/); teeth renamed test_every_standing_tester_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_tester_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_tester_probes_report_to_the_watch. Structure, in full: imports importlib, json, subprocess, sys, Path; _REPO_ROOT on sys.path; parse_workflow from cairn.tools.base.transitions; watchme_spec_error from cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec; _main_tree() = Path(git -C _REPO_ROOT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir).parent falling back to _REPO_ROOT; _tickets() = _main_tree().parent/'CairnCommons'/'tickets'; _standing() = (id, doc, spec) for each ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme spec's probe starts with BERTH, asserting non-empty; the posts tooth imports each probe module and asserts PROBE.verb == 'watch', PROBE.to == 'harbor_master', payload({}) carries ticket == the id, holds a bool, non-empty finding when holds is False (invariants only); the receiver tooth asserts spec['receiver'] == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error(doc) names no receiver fault; a __main__ block runs each, prints PASS/FAIL, exits 1 on any failure. No classes.

D4: the specs' receiver — Ticket files are /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/<id>-<slug>.json (glob '<id>-*.json', exactly one). For each of 299d4f72ae40, 4431cf2bc625, 481221f45884, 652965bec418, a48f95c51a41, f50706ba15c3: doc = json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); the watchme is a dict or list of dicts; the spec whose 'probe' starts with 'cairn/devices/tester/probes/' gets spec['receiver'] = {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}; then cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(p, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver, harbor_master\'s watch verb (71189b2ddffc)') — write(path, text, *, verb, why), text the WHOLE modified ticket. Run it as a script file (a shell command naming a record path and writing is refused by the artifact gate).

D5: green, seal, commit — Run cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_tester_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0) and the probe-importing proofs (test_a_first_seal_is_taken_under_the_seal, test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped, test_validation_store); each must be green. Seal with `bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_tester_probes_report_to_the_watch.py <the probe-importing proofs>` (it runs each and writes its validation beside it). Commit with message '71189b2ddffc: tester probes report to the watch' (the commit runs the reseal ladder, so allow an hour); commit the commons.
